subject: venezuela-oil
story_title: The White House named a private operator, a 35 percent stake, and 100-year rights to 17 Venezuelan oil fields

sub_events.label: White House fact sheet on the NABEP concessions
White House follow-up, warrants record, Wright in Caracas
Crude and gasoline around the fact sheet

records.title: Fact Sheet: Historic Oil Agreement
records.quote: 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields with proven reserves of approximately 65 billion barrels.
records.about: The August 31 fact sheet naming NABEP, 17 fields, the 35 percent equity stake, and the 20 percent cost-price off-take right.

records.title: President Trump Secures the Biggest Oil Deal in World History
records.quote: already produces 250K barrels of oil a day
records.about: The September 2 White House follow-up: private-company framing, 250,000 barrels a day, production as soon as early next year.

records.title: Executive Order 14373
records.quote: Executive Order 14373
records.about: The January 9 order creating Foreign Government Deposit Funds for Venezuelan oil revenue held at Treasury.

records.title: Venezuela General License No. 46D
records.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
records.quote: Effective August 27, 2026, General License No. 46C
records.about: The August 27 general license authorizing established U.S. entities to handle Venezuelan-origin oil if payments go to the deposit funds.

records.title: Issuance of Amended Venezuela-related General Licenses
records.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
records.quote: Issuance of Amended Venezuela-related General Licenses and Associated Frequently Asked Questions
records.about: OFAC's August 27 action list replacing several Venezuela general licenses.

records.title: NABEP statement on the U.S. deal
records.quote: more than $209 billion in tax revenue for the Venezuelan state.
records.about: The company's August 31 statement: 35 percent, 20 percent at cost, $209 billion, 1 million barrels a day goal.

records.title: Venezuela anuncia historico acuerdo con el gobierno de EEUU
records.publisher: Ministerio del Poder Popular para Relaciones Exteriores
records.quote: más de 100 mil millones de dólares en inversiones directas
records.about: The Venezuelan foreign ministry's August 28 post of Rodriguez's Telegram announcement.

records.title: Presidenta Delcy Rodriguez se dirige al pais sobre el gran acuerdo energetico
records.publisher: Ministerio del Poder Popular para Relaciones Exteriores
records.quote: 209 mil 335 millones de dólares para el Estado venezolano
records.about: Rodriguez's address: $209.335 billion at $65 a barrel, about $19 a barrel, 16 percent royalties.

records.title: Arriba a Venezuela Secretario de Energia de EEUU
records.publisher: Ministerio del Poder Popular para Relaciones Exteriores
records.quote: Christopher Wright
records.about: Energy Secretary Wright's arrival in La Guaira. The ministry page is dated 01-09-2026 and says he arrived 'este martes' (Tuesday, September 1). DOE says he traveled September 2.

records.title: Inicia nueva era energetica tras alianzas con Chevron
records.publisher: Ministerio del Poder Popular para Relaciones Exteriores
records.quote: Chevron expande
records.about: Rodriguez on September 2 saying Chevron is expanding in Venezuela.

records.title: WTI Cushing spot prices
records.publisher: U.S. Energy Information Administration via FRED
records.about: Daily Cushing crude prices, including August 31 and September 1, 2026.

records.title: U.S. all-grades gasoline, weekly
records.publisher: U.S. Energy Information Administration via FRED
records.about: EIA weekly retail gasoline, all grades, weeks ending August 24 and August 31.

records.title: STEO Venezuela crude production
records.about: August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook table 3d, Venezuela crude, January through July 2026.

records.title: U.S. crude proved reserves, annual
records.about: Last published EIA annual U.S. crude proved reserves on this table: 41,151 million barrels at year-end 2021, released December 30, 2022.

records.title: White House fills in some details of Venezuela oil agreement
records.quote: oil refiners to discuss ways to increase America’s capacity to refine oil into gasoline
records.about: AP on the fact sheet: 17 fields, 35 percent, 20 percent, and a refiners meeting the next day.

records.title: Trump administration unveils additional details in Venezuela oil deal
records.quote: 21 percent
records.about: The Hill's write-up of the fact sheet, including a 21 percent share of Venezuela's estimated oil.

records.title: White House unveils more details of Trump's Venezuela oil deal
records.quote: Pentagon a stake in roughly one-fifth
records.about: Al Jazeera on the fact sheet, attaching a one-fifth country share to the Pentagon stake.

records.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal will rely on North American Blue Energy Partners
records.quote: roughly one-fifth of Venezuela's total proven oil reserves
records.about: CBS splits the 65 billion barrels as about one-fifth of Venezuela's total and the 35 percent as a company stake.

records.title: Will Trump's Venezuela oil deal ease U.S. gas prices?
records.quote: gas prices
records.about: CBS on whether the deal would move U.S. pump prices quickly.

records.title: Days after Trump announces Venezuela oil deal, White House fills in some of the details
records.quote: creating a private company as a joint venture
records.about: NPR, from AP, using joint-venture wording the fact sheet does not use.

records.title: US firm to take over some Venezuela oilfields previously run by Chinese, Russian firms
records.quote: Five of 14 contracts had been operated by Chinese companies
records.about: Reuters, from officials: 17 projects total, 14 newly granted; Chinese and Russian operators displaced; NABEP previously owned by Harry Sargeant.

records.title: Chevron and the Venezuela oil deal
records.quote: Chevron
records.about: AP on Chevron's separate track in Venezuela, not the NABEP concession.

records.title: Chevron expected to expand oil operations in Venezuela, U.S. official says
records.quote: Chevron expected to expand
records.about: PBS, from a U.S. official, on Chevron expanding, a different operator from NABEP.

records.title: Chevron, ONGC, GE Vernova on track to sign final pacts
records.quote: Chevron, ONGC, GE Vernova
records.about: Reuters sources on other companies signing pacts, not the 17-field NABEP concession.

records.title: Delcy Rodriguez defends oil deal with Trump
records.quote: Venezuela retains the ownership and sovereignty over its resources.
records.about: The Guardian's record of Rodriguez saying Venezuela keeps ownership, and of domestic opposition.

records.title: Angie Nixon on the Venezuela deal
records.quote: Angie Nixon
records.about: Fox's September 1 record of FL Senate candidate Angie Nixon criticizing the deal. Not a congressional roll call.

records.title: U.S. Crude Oil and Natural Gas Proved Reserves, Year-end 2024
records.quote: 46.0 billion barrels at year-end 2024
records.about: EIA's April 7, 2026, report: U.S. crude and lease condensate proved reserves were 46.0 billion barrels at year-end 2024.

records.title: DOE fact sheet on Wright in Venezuela
records.quote: Secretary Wright traveled to Venezuela to oversee the signing of landmark energy agreements with Chevron, Eni, and GE Vernova
records.about: Energy Department fact sheet for Wright's September 2 trip and the Chevron, Eni, and GE Vernova signings.

records.title: Secretary Rubio with Sergio Novelli
records.quote: this really is not an agreement with the interim government. It is an agreement with a private company
records.about: State Department transcript of Rubio's September 1 interview: the deal is with a private company, not the interim government.

records.title: Alejandro Betancourt, the controversial Venezuelan oil tycoon
records.quote: Alejandro Betancourt
records.about: France 24 naming Betancourt as NABEP's operator, which the White House fact sheet does not.

records.title: Truth Social post on the Venezuela oil agreement
records.publisher: Donald J. Trump via Truth Social
records.quote: entered into an Agreement with the Country of Venezuela
records.about: Friday's announcement: majority control of more than 65 billion barrels, doubles American oil reserves, lower gas prices.

records.title: Trump says US has a deal to take huge stake in Venezuela oil reserves
records.quote: effectively controlling 55 percent of the venture’s output
records.about: A U.S. official's Friday arithmetic: 55 percent effective control of output; second-largest after Saudi Aramco.

records.title: BBC on the Venezuela oil agreement
records.quote: the US government will retain 55% control of a joint venture
records.about: BBC, from a U.S. official via CBS: 55 percent control; also records Hormuz supply disruption that week.

records.title: Fox on AAA gas prices and the 55 percent interest
records.quote: $4.08 per gallon for regular gasoline, up from $3.20 a year ago, according to AAA
records.about: AAA regular-grade average $4.08; 55 percent effective interest; Iran war cited as pushing pump prices.

records.title: AP via KPBS on 55 percent effective output
records.quote: 55% effective output of the new private company
records.about: AP Friday dispatch via KPBS: 55 percent effective output; second largest after Saudi Aramco.

records.title: Dow Jones on Pentagon penny warrants
records.quote: structure the investment through penny warrants
records.about: WSJ text carried by Dow Jones via TradingView: OSC penny warrants, 35 percent passive stake, Betancourt investigations without formal charges.

records.title: Semafor on the Office of Strategic Capital
records.quote: does not take equity stakes
records.about: Pentagon spokesman told Reuters OSC does not take equity; a U.S. official later said penny-warrant authority came with the statute.

records.title: Reuters on anti-dilution warrants (via BOE Report)
records.quote: right but not the obligation to buy the equity at a later date
records.about: Reuters text carried by BOE Report: 35 percent as penny warrants against dilution; concessions without a competitive process. reuters.com returned 401.

records.title: Reuters on warrants and right of first offer (via Investing.com)
records.quote: dividends before the warrants are ever exercised
records.about: Same Reuters warrants story via Investing.com: dividends before exercise; right of first offer on output. reuters.com returned 401.

records.title: Reuters on 14 of 17 projects (via Investing.com)
records.quote: Fourteen of those projects will be newly granted by the Venezuelan government
records.about: Reuters text via Investing.com: 17 projects total, 14 newly granted; Chinese and Russian prior operators.

records.title: Guardian on Machado and the oil deal
records.quote: The wealth of our subsoil does not belong to an illegitimate regime
records.about: Maria Corina Machado on September 3: subsoil belongs to the people; U.S. is the principal partner Venezuela needs.

records.title: Reuters on Machado via MarketScreener
records.quote: The United States is the principal partner Venezuela needs to fully develop its strategic potential
records.about: Reuters text via MarketScreener: Machado video Thursday; also Reuters figure of about 1.25 million barrels a day. reuters.com returned 401.

records.title: Senator Jack Reed statement on the Venezuela oil deal
records.quote: blatant abuse of power and taxpayer dollars
records.about: Reed's August 29 statement rejecting use of the military as an investor in Venezuelan oil.

records.title: AP: questions remain on the Venezuela oil deal
records.quote: corruption at epic scale
records.about: Senate reactions from Moreno, Kaine, and Van Hollen.

records.title: Ley de Reforma de la Ley Orgánica de Hidrocarburos
records.publisher: Gaceta Oficial de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela
records.quote: Duración máxima de veinticinco (25) años
records.about: Gaceta Oficial N° 6.978 Extraordinario: mixed companies capped at 25 years plus up to 15. The new hydrocarbons law the White House fact sheet names.

records.title: OilPrice copy of Machado remarks
records.quote: Machado Backs U.S. Oil Partnership
records.about: Second copy of Machado's September 3 coverage.

records.title: Washington Post Venezuela/Chevron page (subscription stub)
records.quote: Washington Post
records.about: Saved page served only a subscription stub (3,404 characters of text), not the full article.
